messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — miniweek for the Northstar webinar next Wed. We need X + LinkedIn posts, two variants for each, asset checklist, and inbound lead routing. Who can own copy + scheduling?
Raj Patel: I can take copy + scheduling for X. Need final hero image and 16:9 for LI.
Olivia Gomez: Uploading final assets to Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (folder: northstar-webinar-assets). added 1200x628 + 1080x1080 + thumbnail.
Taylor King: For messaging: propose A/B on headline — A: "Cut LLM inference latency by 3x" B: "Reduce inference cost without quality loss". Which should be main for LinkedIn?
Maria Chen: Good options. LinkedIn leans toward benefit-first (B). X we can test both.
Jamal Rivers: Routing question — do we capture leads with HubSpot form + UTM, or route comments -> SDR DM? Prefer form + auto-assignment.
Raj Patel: HubSpot form works. Jamal, can you set an automation to assign leads with utm_campaign=northstar-miniweek to SDR queue?
Jamal Rivers: Yep. I'll create workflow and share the trigger. Also adding tag: webinar_northstar_0426.
sam_bot: Reminder: Publish windows suggested by analytics: X optimal Tue 10:30 PST, Wed 09:30 PST, Post-event Thu 11:00 PST.
Olivia Gomez: Copy note: include CTA to register + calendar add link. I'll add 2 headline lengths and 1 short body for X, 1 long post for LI.
Taylor King: For A/B tracking use ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=northstar_splitA/B and append variant param. Raj, can you set two scheduled posts with the different utm values?
Raj Patel: Yep. Scheduling both in Buffer now. ETA by EOD Monday.
Maria Chen: Follow-up cadence for inbound leads: immediate thank-you email + 2-day nurture with benchmarking doc, then SDR outreach at day 4. Jamal ok?
Jamal Rivers: Works. I'll map the nurture to the workflow and add the benchmarking one-pager as attachment.
Taylor King: Benchmarks to surface in posts: expected token-cost reduction, median latency improvements, and a customer quote. Olivia, can you surface a short quote we can feature?
Olivia Gomez: Pulling quote from beta customer doc — sharing in the asset folder as "short-quote.txt".
Maria Chen: Engagement follow-ups: ask 3rd day thread reply prompt like "What’s your biggest inference bottleneck?" to drive comments + warm leads. Raj can pin reply to boost thread.
Raj Patel: Will do. Also add 1 variant with a GIF to test creative engagement.
Taylor King: Measurement: primary KPI = webinar registrations; secondary = social CTR and demo requests. Benchmarks: CTR target 2.2% on X, 1.1% on LI. We will review in Monday morning sync.
Maria Chen: Owners recap — Copy & scheduling X: Raj; LinkedIn long copy + quote: Olivia; HubSpot workflow + SDR routing: Jamal; Assets + thumbnails: Olivia; Tracking + UTMs: Taylor.
Olivia Gomez: Uploaded final copy drafts and the quote. Check Drive.
Raj Patel: Buffer scheduled drafts are in Queue with UTMs and variants — need approvals.
Maria Chen: Quick approvals: @Raj, @Olivia, @Taylor please review drafts in Buffer and approve by EOD Monday. After that we roll. :thumbsup:
Taylor King: Reviewing now, will leave comments in Buffer.
Jamal Rivers: I'll message SDRs to expect the incoming lead flow.
sam_bot: Note: calendar reminder set for publish windows and post-event analysis (1 week after webinar).
Maria Chen: Thanks team — feels tight but good. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
